Asha Rao (CS): Quick notes from ClearWave onboarding call — captured asks + pain points, putting here for triage.
Tom Nguyen (PM): Can you drop the raw list? I'll map to roadmap buckets.
Asha Rao (CS): Raw notes below. Short and messy.
- Feature request: tenant-level model pinning in Console (they want to lock a customer to a specific model+version during migration windows).
- Feature request: per-query SLA tagging + cost-labels (finance needs to attribute tokens to product flows).
- Feature request: lightweight quantization recommendation tool (explain perf vs quality and suggest profiles).
- Pain: intermittent cold-start latency spikes on low-traffic endpoints (observed 300–800ms first-token tails).
- Pain: Private installs missing request/response correlation headers in audit logs — hard for their compliance team to tie requests to user IDs.
Priya Patel (Eng): On the cold-start: sounds like kernel warmup + JIT paths. Short-term mitigations: tiny warm pool per-tenant or async compile during off-peak. Long-term: reduce lazy compilation overhead. Need sample traces.
Liam O'Connor (Product): Model pinning looks urgent for renewals — customers want predictable behavior during rollouts. SLA tagging is urgent for procurement (P0). Quant tool is nice-to-have.
Tom Nguyen (PM): Priya — rough eng estimate? I want to set expectations before the next customer checkpoint.
Priya Patel (Eng): Warm pool pilot: ~2w (infra + autoscaler tweak), cost tradeoff is increased reserved GPU minutes. Audit header propagation: ~3d if just pass-through, ~1w if we need KMS/HSM touches. Console model-pin UI: ~3–4w product+frontend+backend. Quant recommendation: research spike 2w, then UI 2w.
Asha Rao (CS): Customer also asked for a simple cost-justification spreadsheet and a short enablement session next Tue.
Tom Nguyen (PM): Proposed prioritization:
- SLA tagging & cost-labeling -> P0 -> owner: Tom Nguyen -> ETA: 3w -> reason: procurement/renewal blocker
- Tenant model-pinning UI -> P1 -> owner: Liam O'Connor -> ETA: next quarter -> reason: lowers rollout risk for large customers
- Warm-pool cold-start pilot -> P1 -> owner: Priya Patel -> ETA: 2w pilot -> reason: immediate perf pain for low-traffic tenants
- Audit header propagation -> P2 -> owner: Asha Rao -> ETA: 1w to spec, then engineering backlog
- Quantization recommendation tool -> P2 -> owner: TBD -> ETA: research first
Liam O'Connor (Product): I'll take UI design and backlog, can attach a mock for the console flow by EOD Fri.
deploy-bot: Created ticket CS-4512: "ClearWave — SLA tagging & cost-labels" assigned to Tom Nguyen, due 3w.
Asha Rao (CS): Can we ensure the ticket includes a small "smoke test prompt set" so CS can validate regressions?
Priya Patel (Eng): Agreed. Recommend 10 representative prompts (long-tail + edge cases).
Tom Nguyen (PM): Added note about smoke-test prompts and finance acceptance criteria. I'll draft a short PRD by Friday.
Asha Rao (CS): I'll upload the call recording + the customer's spreadsheet to /customers/clearwave/onboard and schedule the enablement slot.
Tom Nguyen (PM): @Liam thanks, please invite procurement and solutions.
Liam O'Connor (Product): Invite sent for Tue 11:00 — added product + eng.
Asha Rao (CS): Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the customer with the spreadsheet and confirm the pilot scope. :thumbsup:
Tom Nguyen (PM): :rocket:
Priya Patel (Eng): Will start scoping warm-pool infra tomorrow and post a short runbook.
Asha Rao (CS): tagging note: customer asked for simple billing CSV export for their finance team — please include in SLA ticket.
Tom Nguyen (PM): Done. Closing loop here, will update the ticket as PRD lands.
